column1: # rspinyin development word list (L2 words + L4 frequencies).
#   * reading  optional. An empty or absent column means "compose the L3a
#              baseline reading from the L1 single-character table"
#              (data/raw/pinyin-data.tsv). A reading may be written with tone
#              apostrophes (`yin'hang`) or as one run of letters (`yinhang`);
#              dictc folds all four forms onto the toneless syllable table.
#   * weight   optional. Absent means the per-length default: 1 char 40000,
#              The weights below approximate the source corpus counts of
#              data/raw/jieba-dict.tsv, which is what ranks candidates that
#              combination, or the equivalent bit mask.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# This file is a development subset: the release dictionary is generated from
# the whole whitelisted sources by the release build matrix and is not committed.
# The subset is frequency-stratified on purpose. L3b expands the words at or
# above the band floor, which dictc derives from the L4 source's frequency
# ranking (the weight of the 50,000th most frequent entry, ADR-0000's "top 50k"
# band). A subset drawn only from the head of the ranking would expand every word
# it holds and measure a key growth that has nothing to do with production;
# keeping a tail of mid-frequency words reproduces the production expansion ratio
# instead. Roughly 30% of the rows below sit at or above the floor.
# Every word here is a real entry of the L2/L4 source; the subset itself is
# project-owned (MIT OR Apache-2.0) because it is derived data.
# ── two-character words at or above the expansion band ─────────────────────
# ── two-character words in the mid-frequency band ──────────────────────────
# ── four-character words, mid and low frequency ────────────────────────────
# ── single characters, second and third frequency tiers ────────────────────
# ── four-character compounds, mid and low frequency ────────────────────────
# ── two-character words below the band, by domain ──────────────────────────
# ── two-character words below the band: actions, qualities, states ─────────
# ── two-character words at the band floor ──────────────────────────────────
